main_text.p: cordium : de statu dejicit animum, ubi incidit ex improviso, consternat & percellit, & sponte sequacem,pellicit in lasciviam, aut ægrè sub luƈta sibi constante pugili, ovat interim invidendâ facilitate: Agnosceres hîc imperium simile Virtutis imperio:blandum est utrumque, sed potens, suave, non violentum, utrumque confusione plecƈit rebelles. Concessisse proinde nonnihil,& paruisse satius est, ò Ingenuitas, quam indigno rubore palloreque vapulari refractariam: Obsequio devincîtur illa potentia, congressu, colloquio, familiaritate cicuratur : Exteros attonitos habet Majestas, non suos: Noƈturni Manium bombi non terrent vespillones : Quidquid ad cotem Panici pavoris acuitur, hoc aciem perdit & hebescit usu. Est & ingenio perutilis labor, quem

page.notes: Right margin: cut-off marginal notes from the facing page are largely illegible; not transcribed. Words at line ends with dashes (ani-, pugi-, facilita-, confusio-, indigno, il-, cicuratur) were treated as printed hyphens. Possible printing error "luƈta" read as "luƈta" (lucta); "satius" line-end words rendered as printed.
